scientific_integrity: All-degree result is proved analytically; exact radical comparison is separately checked. No independent verification or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: D-optimality is only within the prescribed pole-plus-odd-ring grid, not arbitrary sphere samples; it does not imply best condition number, noise tolerance, or global latitude formulas at every bandwidth. An older equivalent optimal-design calculation may exist.
title: Exact nested-latitude Fourier determinants and the unique nine-sample spherical D-optimum
